name: Button Mystery: Horror Room Escape
summary:
You wake up in a strange room with no idea how you got there.

Mannequins stand silently in the corners. Furniture is scattered around you. Endless buttons cover the walls.

No instructions. No clues. No obvious escape.

Just buttons.

Button Mystery: Horror Room Escape is a VR puzzle, adventure, and psychological horror experience where memory and observation matter.
